I currently struggle with occipital neuralgia and have nerve block injections into my head…after an issue at the hospital where I was mistakenly denied some treatment, I was obviously very upset. I phoned the GP practise to see if they could help and I explained the situation (all whilst sounding upset on the phone) when I say the receptionist who answered has restored my faith that people do care….she was SO lovely. She reassured me that she would get the Dr to phone me the same day. She told me not to worry and that we would get it sorted. I didn’t get her name, but she was working at 1pm on Thursday 15th May. She was so kind and really made me gain hope back.

Equally, Dr Hussain was really great and phoned me straight back. He was empathetic and listened to me. He also has put measures in place to help.

I felt proud to be part of the practise today.
